study_guide.title: Cane and the Giant Storm

pages.text: Cane the Weather Dog lives near the ocean, where the water is warm and blue. One day, far out over the ocean, a giant spinning storm was growing. It was a hurricane. "A hurricane is born over the warm ocean," said Cane. "The warm water is its food, and it grows very, very big." Right in the middle of the hurricane is a calm, quiet spot. It is called the eye. But Cane was not worried. Hurricanes take a long time to arrive, so there is plenty of time to get ready.
pages.ask: How big? So big you could see it from space! Can you spread your arms out wide, wide, wide?

pages.text: "When a big storm is coming," said Cane, "we make a plan early!"
Cane helped his family pack a prep kit. In went water, a flashlight, batteries, and some food. They made a plan for where to go and how to stay together.
pages.ask: Can you name one thing to put in a prep kit?

pages.text: When Cane was ready, he felt calm and safe. He knew his family had a good plan. "Great job, weather helper," said Cane. "Getting ready early keeps us safe. You are weather-ready!"

study_guide.rule: Big storms — we make a plan early!

a giant spinning storm from the warm ocean

to get ready before something happens
the big space above us where weather happens
